Save, Revert, and your unsaved-changes status remain visible while you scroll.- Small screens, fewer gymnastics. Tighter layouts keep settings usable in smaller windows. events.title: Last Paddle Standing - Demo Update #2.2
events.summary: Online play: more updates, less dataWhen you join someone else’s match, the host sends updates showing where the ball and paddles are. This patch improves both how those updates travel and how your game displays them.- Twice as many updates: the host now sends 60 updates per second instead of 30—roughly one every 17 milliseconds instead of 33. events.title: Last Paddle Standing — Demo Update #1
events.summary: Demo Patch 1 — Perks, House Rules, a New Look & Smoother Online Play The demo's first patch is here, and it's a big one. This update rebuilds the systems that shape a match, perk drafts, ability drops and house rules, polishes the arena's visual effects, and fixes the two biggest thorns: rubber-banding on your own paddle, and balls slipping through paddles they should have hit.
